payload.text: **An inbound ask is stored in the RECIPIENT's board.json, which is canon, and only the recipient commits it.** The sender's wb ask re-renders the recipient's inbox view and the sender commits that view with its event, but the message itself lands in <recipient>/board.json, which stays uncommitted on main until the recipient commits its own paths. Until then every fresh worktree (every builder's gate) fails doctor with view skew on that inbox: the committed view shows a message the committed canon cannot render. Found 22 Oct 18:00Z local when cc's 0015 gate refused on vc/inbox.cc.md (12018 on disk, 7254 rendered). Rule: whenever you commit anything, include your own board.json; and after a peer's ask or your own clear, commit board.json at once. A fresh detached worktree and a read-only intent doctor reproduce the gate's view.
